name: auto-triage-pipeline
description: A full-page view of Kiro Crew's own auto-triage pipeline: one horizontal lane per crew work item across the phase enum, so an operator sees at a glance which phase each item is in, where items are piling up, and which have stalled. Reads the crew ledger through Issue Radar's crew-fabric seam — the lane drawing answers 'where is this item', a queue summary answers 'how is the queue doing'.
author: kirocrew
useCases: See where Issue Radar crew work is accumulating, reopening, or waiting across the full delivery pipeline.
configuration: Connect a repository in Issue Radar and let its crew ledger collect phase events, then enable this app and choose that repository from the picker.
